verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity, fraud and compliance platform that stores customer and investigation data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack never documents retention periods, deletion endpoints, or data-purge settings. It only notes that Alloy stores event data and mentions entity merging, which is adjacent functionality and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure or verify retention and deletion behavior for customer and investigation data
